— The Ancient Journey

8000 Years of Millet Wisdom

You are not eating a snack. You are connecting with 80 centuries of civilisational legacy.

8000 BCE
Ancient Civilisation
Millets first cultivated in the Indus Valley — the world's original superfood.
3000 BCE
Vedic Period
Ancient texts called millets "Shree Anna" — the sacred grain that fed kingdoms.
1960s
Green Revolution
Wheat and rice replaced millets. An 8000-year tradition was nearly forgotten.
2023
UN Year of Millets
India led the world in declaring 2023 the International Year of Millets at the UN.
2026
Amritan Reborn
Amritan reimagines this ancient grain as a premium modern snack for today's India.
🌿
Gluten Free
Perfect for celiac patients. Enjoy classic Indian snacks without wheat worries.
📉
Low Glycemic Index
Slower glucose release keeps blood sugar stable. Ideal for diabetics.
💪
Boosts Immunity
Rich in iron, calcium and antioxidants — naturally strengthening your immune system.
🌍
Sustainable Crop
Drought-resistant and climate-resilient. Choosing Amritan means choosing the planet.

— Our Story

Born from
Ancient Roots

Amritan bridges the gap from traditional grain to modern plate. We took 8000-year-old millet wisdom and reimagined it as premium, ready-to-eat snacks for today's health-seeking urban consumer.

Taste-First, Healthy-Second — Great health food should not taste like medicine.
FPO Partnerships — Directly sourced from farmer producer organisations across India.
Zero Compromise — 100% millet, no fillers, no artificial flavours, no gluten.
